call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Generate exactly ONE finished flat launch poster, portrait 4:5. Preserve that ratio and output at the maximum resolution currently supported by this tool and model. The image itself is the whole poster, with photograph and typography rendered together. No mockup, paper frame, panels, alternatives, contact sheet, or decorative border.

The entire composition is organized by the height saved when ONE cup folds down. Make a tightly framed, optically coherent comparison photograph of the SAME handleless 350mL dark forest-green silicone cup, expanded at the left and collapsed at the right, on one continuous matte warm apricot-orange photographic surface and backdrop. Use a warm color with actual controlled photographic light, not an ordinary gray catalog background. The dark-green material must still look naturally green. Both cup states stand on the SAME baseline and ground plane. Use a lightly elevated frontal view so both matching frosted translucent-white lids and their top ellipses remain visible. Keep the full lids, bases and silhouette relationships legible. The photograph is purposefully large within the frame, with only useful breathing room and no large unused top or bottom margin.

Lock the two states as the same design. Their rim diameters, lid diameters, base diameters, axis orientation and perspective MUST correspond. Use a compact, broad, slightly tapered cup with THREE concentric accordion folding sections, rounded fold joints and a stable circular base narrower than its rim. Expanded: three compatible concentric silicone sections are extended. Collapsed: those SAME three sections are folded into a low nested stack above the SAME unchanged base, retaining discernible consistent fold joints. The collapsed base must not become wider, its rim must not become smaller, and it must not gain or lose wall sections. Match silicone thickness and taper in both states. Do not stretch the expanded 350mL cup into a vase. Both matching fitted lids are genuinely frosted, milky translucent white, with soft transmitted light through the edges, not opaque solid white caps. No handle, spout, straw, hands, accessories or props. Products have entirely unmarked surfaces.

Use a single broad directional side light with restrained warm reflected fill. Photographic matte silicone texture, gentle believable highlights, clean but natural edges, visible weight and contact shadows under both bases, and consistent shadows on the shared surface. The lids respond differently from the opaque green bodies. No floating objects, harsh CGI plastic sheen, cutout halo, mirrored reflections or melted folds.

Design the type and photograph together. The expanded left silhouette and the lower right lid create a stepped available space above the collapsed cup. Use that space to organize the WHOLE identity, product name, folding claim, specification, release, preorder and complete URL. Their alignments and relative heights must visibly respond to the two product heights. Keep the seven values in a continuous, articulated reading path between the higher lid and lower lid, with clean warm negative space around every glyph. Do not detach release and preorder into a remote bottom footer, separate strip, or unrelated upper margin.

Make FOLN a genuinely small identifier. Make Fold Cup the clearly largest and deliberately articulated name, using two confident lines if helpful: Fold above Cup with clear word separation and exact capital F and C, lowercase remaining letters. Its width, line spacing and placement engage the cup heights; it must not be a generic small caption. Follow with a readable Korean claim of medium weight, then the specification as its own supporting role. Distinguish the release information from the preorder action using clear spacing and weight. Keep the full preorder wording and date range together as one semantic group; place the full URL immediately in its reading path. The support information must NOT all be equal-size dense labels. Allocate enough space for the longest required line before setting product scale. Word-boundary line breaks are allowed, including between the preorder words and dates, but retain every character and word gap. All seven values, especially the specification, complete preorder range and full URL, must read comfortably when the poster is displayed at width 720px. Type stays off products and their shadows. High dark-green/charcoal type contrast, intentional optical alignment, clean Korean strokes and disciplined spacing.

Print only the following seven exact copy values, once each. Preserve spelling, Korean words, case, spaces, dates and punctuation. Preserve the visible space in 350 mL, the middle dot, and the en dash without spaces inside the numeric range. Natural line breaks do not authorize copy editing:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

No additional slogans, captions, state labels, measurements, logos, symbols, arrows, rules, boxes, price, certification, watermark, fake microtext or ornamental collage. No letters on the products or photographic surface. Exactly one portrait 4:5 flat poster with the same green cup's expanded and collapsed states and all seven exact values, at the maximum supported native resolution.

Support copy has clear weight differences, but most lines still follow one conventional right-side column. The name-to-photo relation has not fully escaped the catalog composition.
